volunteering.title: Speaker, Mentor, Scholar Reviewer, Moderator - AnitaB.org
description: ‣ Invited as a GHC 2026 Speaker for the session “Off-Script: Make Impact Your Main Track”, after years of continued involvement across the community.
‣ Served across multiple leadership and support roles.
‣ Leadership Track: vGHC’21 Scholar → vGHC’21 Moderator → GHC’23 Scholar Reviewer → Mentor → GHCI’24 Scholar → GHCI’25 Ambassador & Volunteer Co-Lead → GHC’26 Speaker

volunteering.title: Ambassador, Volunteer Co-lead - AnitaB.org India
description: ‣ Served as a Grace Hopper Celebration India Ambassador, driving awareness and participation across diverse student and professional communities.
‣ Recognized as Top Ambassador for GHCI 2025, leading the leaderboard with 65 verified missions completed.
‣ Served as GHCI Volunteer Co-Lead, supporting 100+ volunteers and helping execute a 6,000+ attendee conference with 350+ speakers.

volunteering.title: Mentor - Rewriting the Code
description: ‣ Mentored community members through regular 1:1 coffee chats and career guidance sessions.
‣ Conducted live résumé review and interview prep workshops for students and early-career professionals.
‣ Led mentoring circles on conference prep, interviews, and career growth, and was recognized as a Top Mentor for 2025.

volunteering.title: Co-founder, CGEC Alumni Mentorship Program - Cooch Behar Government Engineering College
description: ‣ Co-founded the CGEC Alumni Mentorship Program to connect alumni with the next generation of student engineers.
